verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware security keys for FIDO2/U2F, PIV and OTP authentication. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a category error for a physical authenticator. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any scheduling or workflow capability; HOTP keyboard emulation is a one-off typed credential, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
